items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap were trading 0.36 per cent and 0.31 per cent higher, respectively

items.title: NSE, PhonePe to lead IPO wave as 239 firms line up to list, say analysts
items.description: According to Prime Database data, 21 IPOs are opening in August, up from 12 in July. This marks a sharp spike from the first half of the year.

items.title: IPO frenzy: Why retail investors need to look beyond subscription, GMP buzz
items.description: What attracts retail investors to an IPO is primarily the buzz created around the issue on social media, grey markets, and the level of subscription.

items.title: Lumino Industries IPO: GMP at 60%; analysts recommend 'subscribe' tag
items.description: The shares of Lumino Industries are slated to list on BSE and NSE with a tentative date set as September 3.
